annotations.text:
Synthetic Cubism, bold
Flat color-block planes, doubled profile/frontal eyes, patterned fabric. The loudest, most "recognizably Picasso" option — leading candidate.

Analytic Cubism, muted
Faceted earth-tone planes, barely-legible form. Quieter and more austere — closer to 1910 Picasso/Braque.

Blue Period, melancholic
A hunched figure with a guitar, monochrome blue, representational. Moodier and more figurative than the cubist options.
